title: Arrival Of Cantonese Notables

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 25,000-I-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY / File No. / No. D 4024 / Date 16 / 9 / 32 / Date Sept. 16, 1932.）

S.I., Special Branch ____

Subject (in full)____ Arrival of Cantonese Notables.

Made by____ Supt. Tan Shao-liang ____ Forwarded by____ [签名: H.S. Robertson, Supt.]

It is reported that Sun Fo will arrive in
Shanghai on September 23 in company with Admiral Chen
Tsai (political opponent of General Chen Chi-tang of
Canton). Sun Fo will reside at 22 Columbia Road, a
house he has newly bought.
Dr. Wu Chao-chu will arrive at the China
Merchants Central Wharf by the s.s. "Dartagnan" at
1 p.m. to-day, September 16, and reside at 29 Gordon
Road.

[签名: Tan Shaoliang]
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S.O. "B"
please information and return
[签名]
1 1/2 Burrell [签名: R Hellawell] 16/9 16:9:32
Notes return
[签名]
DIVISIONAL OFFICER "B" DIV.

Recd info /
[签名]

Notes
[签名: W.J. Bromich]
DIVISIONAL OFFICER "B" DIV.
page_data.zh:
表格第3号
G. 25,000-I-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与特别股登记室 / 档案号 / 编号 D 4024 / 日期 16 / 9 / 32 / 日期 1932年9月16日。）

特别股 ____

事由（全称）____ 广东名流抵沪。

呈报人____ 巡官谭绍良 ____ 转呈人____ [签名: H.S. Robertson, 巡官]

据报，孙科将于9月23日偕同陈策海军上将（广州陈济棠将军的政治对手）抵达上海。孙科将寓居哥伦比亚路22号，此为其新购之宅邸。
吴朝柱博士将于今日（9月16日）下午1时乘“达塔尼昂”号轮船（s.s. "Dartagnan"）抵达招商局中央码头，并寓居戈登路29号。

[签名: Tan Shaoliang]
巡官。

特别股主管警官。

B区警司
请阅知并退回
[签名]
1 1/2 Burrell [签名: R Hellawell] 16/9 16:9:32
附注退回
[签名]
B区分区警官

已收悉信息 /
[签名]

附注
[签名: W.J. Bromich]
B区分区警官
